name: Leverage Iso Row (Horizontal Grip - Upper Back)
instructions: Adjust the seat height so the chest pad supports your sternum and the horizontal handles align across mid-chest level.
Grasp the horizontal handles using an overhand (pronated) grip with palms facing down.
Keep your chest pinned firmly against the pad and drive your elbows outward and backward at a 60°–80° angle relative to your torso.
Retract and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the peak contraction to maximally recruit the rhomboids, middle/lower trapezius, and rear deltoids.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position until your shoulder blades protract and upper back muscles are fully stretched.
